context.requirement_text: REQ-204 acceptance criteria: (AC1) non-https scheme rejected; (AC2) 5 private-range rejections (127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254, 10.0.0.5, 172.16.0.5, 192.168.0.5); (AC3) legitimate https target succeeds; (AC4) DNS rebinding test in deliver/3; (AC5) no-redirect regression; (AC6) INV-9 added; (AC7) moduledoc ranges; (AC8) mix test passes; (AC9) no scope creep. NOTE: delivery dispatch bypass mechanism: dispatch_http/3 in webhooks.ex checks Application.get_env(:letflow, :webhook_ssrf_validation_enabled, true) and skips validation when false. The REQ-183 delivery tests set this to false in setup/on_exit.

task.description: Validate test coverage for REQ-204. Confirm: (1) all 9 ACs have test coverage; (2) tests are runnable (no syntax issues); (3) DNS injection hook is used correctly for unit tests; (4) AC4 DNS rebinding scenario is properly tested; (5) the Application.get_env bypass in dispatch_http/3 is acceptable idiom for delivery tests.
acceptance_criteria: Every AC has at least one named test
Tests use DNS resolver injection for unit tests (not real DNS)
AC4 DNS rebinding test exercises the deliver/3 path
